sources.title: Zeron README.md
sources.finding: Local use needs no Zeron account; Linux headless service keeps agents on a VPS after laptop closure. Optional same-account sync allows peers to read/write each others workspace files; existing local sessions are not uploaded.

sources.title: Zeron ARCHITECTURE.md
sources.locator: Topology; Headed/headless; Local profiles; Trust boundary
sources.finding: Rust engine and GPUI desktop use the same RPC. Detached engine can survive client quit; local and synced stores are separate. Supported self-hosted sync-backend contract is explicitly deferred, distinct from owned-device execution.

sources.title: Zeron docs/PARITY.md
sources.finding: Native rewrite documents Claude/Codex/ACP integrations, account OAuth/usage controls, worktrees and a patch viewer. Some older checklist gaps are superseded by later targeted docs; no runtime parity test was run here.

sources.title: Zeron docs/mcp.md
sources.finding: zeron mcp exposes authenticated engine tools to create/read/message/wait/stop chats, including one-level cross-provider children. Child chats cannot create further chats.

sources.title: Zeron docs/design/cloud-device.md
sources.locator: Status v1 implementation; Product shape; Vault; lifecycle
sources.finding: Opt-in Cloud starts per-session Boat machines for Claude Code or Codex with separate provider connections. API keys or supported native OAuth accounts are brokered; side chats can share the parent sandbox.

sources.title: Zeron docs/pi.md
sources.finding: Pi runs native RPC with its native UUID/JSONL history, provider-discovered models/effort and queued steering; missing session files may require a visible new-session fallback.

sources.title: Zeron docs/reference/message-queue.md
sources.finding: Durable queue IDs, host-only delivery, explicit edit leases and review gates prevent silent dispatch after uncertain edits or recovery.

sources.title: Zeron docs/reference/project-actions.md
sources.finding: Project actions require explicit import and run on the owning device. New-worktree setup opens a terminal; setup errors are nonblocking and the first agent turn continues.

sources.title: Zeron docs/program-status.md
sources.finding: Desktop/mobile/MCP derive working, needs-input, error, completed and idle states from native/terminal evidence. Expired liveness is stale, not successful completion.

sources.title: Zeron docs/session-publication.md
sources.finding: SQLite outbox journals sync updates before network admission and retains batch IDs for idempotent replay. This does not establish arbitrary relay-loss protection.

sources.title: Zeron docs/background-processes.md
sources.finding: Desktop lists/reads/stops background Claude/Codex commands with runtime-confirmed completion; other harness and mobile tray coverage is explicitly absent.

sources.title: Zeron apps/ios/README.md
sources.finding: Native UIKit iOS client uses Rust core, queues/steers/stops remote host sessions and can open child transcripts and remote PTYs.

sources.title: Zeron apps/android/README.md
sources.finding: Android Jetpack Compose client uses shared Rust core; signed main builds publish an arm64 APK on the official website.

sources.title: Zeron LICENSE
sources.finding: Zeron source is MIT licensed.

sources.title: Zeron official website
sources.locator: Runs what you already use; Downloads
sources.finding: The official site lists macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and iOS downloads, including the iOS App Store and Android APK. It names OpenCode in addition to the README agent list.

sources.title: Zeron developer App Store listing
sources.finding: The developer listing offers the iPhone/iPad companion free for iOS/iPadOS 26+. It starts/steers connected-host sessions and exposes remote terminals; agents require a connected host and provider account.

sources.title: Zeron privacy policy
sources.finding: The policy separates local app data from optional synced transcripts and Cloud credentials. Apps have no analytics/crash SDKs; website PostHog honors browser GPC/DNT. Synced chats are encrypted at rest/in transit, not end-to-end.
